q: The quantum capacity Q of the erasure channel E_p (which erases each qubit with probability p, telling the receiver which qubits were erased) is:
exp: Quantum erasure channel: Q = max(1−2p, 0). For p < 1/2, the quantum capacity is 1−2p bits (strictly less than the classical capacity 1−p). The erasure channel is one of the few for which exact quantum capacity formulas are known.
